name: Holden House Apartments
description: Apartments where HUD helps pay the rent, so what you pay is based on your income (95 such units).
eligibility: Based on income and household size.

steps: Call 937-223-0955 to ask if the wait list is open.
Ask how to apply, and what to bring.
how_to_use.what_to_expect: Each building has its own wait list. Putting your name on several can help.
